reviews.name: damianhanna
reviews.quote: I had a 1on1 Ableton production, mixing and mastering session with Cam and loved the advanced tipps and feedback he gave me. It was great to be able to elevate beyond the basics and also talk creatively about the work with helpful insights.

reviews.name: Shayazfr
reviews.quote: Cam is genuinely passionate about what he does and brings a lot of creativity to his work. From my interactions with him, he's been very approachable, insightful and great to talk about ideas with. Definitely someone worth working with!

reviews.name: Deepak Kumar
reviews.quote:
I received a one-on-one Ableton production masterclass session, we went from zero to creating beats within an hour.

My progress towards music production has vastly improved with a single class than years of watching tutorials online. A hand's on approach was emphasized throughout the session.

Cam has put together an excellent syllabus towards familiarising audio production techniques with patience and humility at every step of the way. I highly reccomend their audio production courses.

reviews.name: 5starlife1
reviews.quote: Cam is a really good teacher and gave a very informative lesson about mixing a finished sound project in Ableton!
